findings.literalSource:
"""
      Substrate-canonical vaporware-collapse gate. vaporize transmutes typed \
      substrate-vaporware into world-state: binaries land, .app installs, \
      processes run, receipts emit. Modes: install, uninstall, build, test, run, \
      pass, use, toolchain-selection, setup. Toolchain selection compiles \
      swiftlang/swiftly's `use` operation into this executable for default Swift \
      selection. Core build, test, install, and run commands use the platform \
      authority grammar documented below.\(platformToolchainSelectionAbstract) Vaporize does not locate \
      or launch an installed swiftly CLI. Toolchain lifecycle, general \
      inspection, and execution remain separate responsibilities. \
      Vaporware-awareness modes: status + warehouse enumerate and \
      store vaporware at a path per the `x-vaporize-collapse-path` annotation \
      convention. Project-generation bridge mode: inspect-project-yml reads \
      legacy XcodeGen YAML into an owned Swift model without rewriting it; \
      compare-project-yml-pkl compares that model with a Pkl parity specimen; \
      import-project-yml emits a Pkl parity specimen from legacy YAML; \
      generate-project-yml emits transitional AppleProjectSpec YAML from Pkl \
      with receipts; generate-xcodeproj emits first-slice .xcodeproj \
      world-state from evaluated AppleProjectSpec Pkl; \
      generate-sparkle-config emits a compiled-in SparkleConfig.swift for a \
      CLI tool target from its project.pkl releaseIdentity; list-targets discovers \
      project targets, packages, and schemes for parity/build routing; \
      list-schemes asks xcodebuild for live .xcworkspace schemes; \
      release-doctor audits the release spine before claims are trusted. \
      homebrew-status compares an owned formula, its typed tap manifest, and \
      the local Homebrew receipt without conflating formula revision with a \
      product build number. \
      fleet-status reports every installed bin-directory tool with its \
      sidecar-recorded version and appcast feed currency \
      (current/behind/critical-behind/feed-unreachable/no-sidecar). \
      version-status reports owner-controlled Apple application source \
      marketing versions and build numbers against the 0.0.x policy, while \
      keeping source, installed, release, and historical-wire evidence \
      boundaries explicit. \
      `inventory` discovers Package.swift, .xcodeproj, .xcworkspace, \
      project.yml, and project.pkl surfaces by domain, product line, and \
      ownership scope. `cuj-audit` inventories CUJ definitions, proof \
      bindings, canonical product homes, and active-owned implementation \
      coverage without conflating fixtures, matrices, receipts, or tests; \
      `--proof-ledger-path` writes the canonical cross-portfolio proof index \
      while `--project-ledger-path` and `--project-ledger-csv-path` write one \
      fine-grained coverage row per active-owned implementation project. \
      Executable tests and green receipts remain in their owning homes. \
      `domains` lists available tool domains from the tools collection. \
      Legacy `x-craze-collapse-path` remains a compatibility alias during migration.
      Target feature inspection mode: inspect-target-features reads a project.yml \
      target, its configFiles wiring, release-features.json, generated xcconfigs, \
      and ReleaseFeatures.swift provenance.
      """

heuristics.description: User-facing copy crosses the target boundary without an approved generated-package passport.
heuristics.name: Missing Passport

heuristics.description: User-facing prose has escaped the typed catalog and is authored loose in product source.
heuristics.name: Loose Copy

heuristics.description: Product code takes a localization side door around the approved generated accessor boundary.
heuristics.name: Side Door

heuristics.description: An approved import dresses the target as adopted while none of its generated accessors are used.
heuristics.name: Costume Import

heuristics.description: Development-only vapor has leaked across the release boundary.
heuristics.name: Vapor Leak

heuristics.description: A generated accessor appears without a reproducible dependency on its owning module.
heuristics.name: Ghost Dependency

heuristics.description: An approved declaration has no live generated-accessor sink in the scanned target.
heuristics.name: Orphaned Declaration

heuristics.description: A copy-shaped module presents no approved publication receipt proving its identity.
heuristics.name: Counterfeit Package

heuristics.description: The generated accessor index cannot account for every declared canonical key exactly once.
heuristics.name: Broken Index

heuristics.description: Multiple imported packages contest ownership of the same canonical key.
heuristics.name: Key Turf War

heuristics.description: A live generated accessor resolves to a key missing from imported publication declarations.
heuristics.name: Undocumented Use

heuristics.description: One imported module answers to multiple approved receipts, splitting publication authority.
heuristics.name: Split Authority

heuristics.description: Multiple generated accessor aliases lead to the same canonical key.
heuristics.name: Alias Maze

heuristics.description: One publication receipt counts the same canonical key more than once.
heuristics.name: Double Entry

heuristics.description: A declared locale shard looks complete but cannot materialize every canonical catalog record into target resources.
heuristics.name: Translation Mirage

heuristics.description: A translation changes, drops, duplicates, or retags formatting placeholders at the locale boundary.
heuristics.name: Placeholder Smuggling

heuristics.description: A locale silently resolves through source-language fallback instead of proving a localized artifact.
heuristics.name: Fallback Fog

heuristics.description: A published locale exists in inventory but no declared product route can reach it.
heuristics.name: Dead Tongue

heuristics.description: A canonical key and its generated accessor diverge from the product's declared key-shape grammar.
heuristics.name: Key Shape Drift

heuristics.description: Distinct meanings are forced through one key without typed context evidence proving that the reuse is intentional.
heuristics.name: Context Collapse
